title: Fighting the New York Times’ invasion of user privacy
summary: OpenAI is fighting the New York Times’ demand for 20 million private ChatGPT conversations and accelerating new security and privacy protections to protect your data.
body: OpenAI is fighting the New York Times’ demand for 20 million private ChatGPT conversations and accelerating new security and privacy protections to protect your data.
summaryZh: OpenAI针对《纽约时报》索取2000万条用户对话数据的要求表示反对，并强调将加速部署新的安全与隐私保护措施。此举反映了AI厂商在数据隐私保护与法律合规方面的立场。原始信息显示：OpenAI is fighting the New York Times’ demand for 20 million private ChatGPT conversations and accelerating new security and privacy protections to protect your data.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Fighting the New York Times’ invasion of user privacy”。其重要性主要体现在：涉及AI模型隐私保护与法律纠纷，对行业合规具有重要意义。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
